summary.text: Elizabeth "Liz" Stefanics is a Democrat who represents District 39 in the New Mexico Senate, covering parts of San Miguel, Santa Fe, Torrance and Valencia counties.
The legislature's member page lists Stefanics as a senator from 1993 to 1996 and again since 2017, and as chair of the Senate Conservation Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Stefanics's occupation as retired and a district office in Santa Fe.
Stefanics also sits on the Senate Rules Committee and, between sessions, is co-chair of the Behavioral Health Subcommittee and vice chair of the Water and Natural Resources Committee.
